services.name: Historical Walking Tour
services.desc: Arnold is a small town where a vibrant history breathes through our streets and buildings. Embark on a self-guided walking tour and let the echoes of the past transport you back in time, immersing you in the inspiring stories of our charming community. Arnold is blessed to have residents that love to photograph the beauty around us. They have willingly shared their photographs with us. Many of the photos on the site and in this photo gallery were taken by Garald Horst, the late Terry King, the late Cheryll Peterson, and many others. Thank you for sharing your talent and eye for beauty with us. Take a stroll through yesterday in Arnold! Grab one of the new historical walking tour brochures

blurb: The Arnold Theatre was first started in 1924. Sadly, in 1979 it was closed down for 18 years. In 1997, Sue Beshaler organized a group of community volunteers who started the current restoration project that is still actively going on today.
